target_customer: Vinyl, cassette and CD collectors buying and selling records online, with sellers paying a 12 percent fee
problem: Record collectors faced a hard to use dominant marketplace that does not process transactions, with limited drops, bots and rising prices.

founders.name: Cam Korzecke
founders.background_notes: Worked on federated deep learning research, compilers and ranking at Google, per YC page.

founders.name: Simeon Goolsby
founders.background_notes: Built music listening and education apps.

founders.name: Christian White
founders.background_notes: Distributed systems for signal processing at Maxar.

competitors.name: Discogs
competitors.what: Dominant online vinyl database and marketplace; the founders say it is hard to use and does not process transactions
competitors.traction_then: Founders claim it facilitates over 600M dollars of vinyl exchanges a year (founder claim)

technical_complexity.rationale: Standard marketplace with payments and listings, built by four software engineers in weeks.

defensibility.rationale: Liquidity on both sides was needed and Discogs already held it; features and fees were easy to match.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found on incumbents copying it.

market_need_then: Founders cited vinyl sales growth of 108 percent in the first half of 2021, pressing plant backlogs and bots buying limited releases; these are founder claims.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence about the brand found; search returned nothing on the name.

outcome_analysis: Nasdisc launched a vinyl, cassette and CD marketplace in mid 2021 and claimed 1 thousand dollars a week in sales and 50 thousand dollars of listings at the YC application. YC lists it as acquired, but no acquirer, date, price or funding is public, and no coverage of the deal or of any shutdown was found, so the outcome and its cause are not public.
notes: Searches for acquisition, funding and branding returned only unrelated companies. nasdisc.com returned HTTP 503 at fetch time, treated as unreachable. Crunchbase shows no funding and placeholder milestones. Discogs source date is the founders' YC description, undated; Reverb LP (a Discogs rival) appeared in results but without a 2021 date. Exit type unknown because YC says Acquired with nothing else.
